page_title: HEI 1-2 LEV | Heidenheim v Bayer Leverkusen 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90+2' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
90+2' Harm Osmers couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) and blew his whistle.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' It's time for a substitution. Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on in place of Amine Adli.
88' Here is a change. Jeremie Frimpong is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
88' Substitution. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Florian Wirtz.
86' 1 - 2 GOAL! Nikola Dovedan connects with a delightful cross and heads it towards Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim), whose header goes past Lukas Hradecky. 1:2.
86' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) was too forceful with his tackle and Harm Osmers interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
84' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will have a throw-in.
84' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benedikt Gimber trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
81' 0 - 2 Florian Wirtz passes to Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
81' Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
80' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

78' OFF THE BAR! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
77' Good work from Heidenheim as they win a corner.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Florian Pick (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Jan-Niklas Beste.
76' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) replaces Eren Dinkci.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) is replacing Patrik Schick.
70' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
67' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) tries to find Eren Dinkci, but he puts too much power on the pass.
66' Heidenheim are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) is coming onto the pitch as Jan Schoppner cannot continue after picking up an injury.

61' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.

58' Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Lukas Hradecky!
56' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
52' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Harm Osmers has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

51' What a long-range shot by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
50' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
49' The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
48' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
48' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Substitution. Adrian Beck walks off the pitch and Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) comes on as a substitute.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Harm Osmers blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' 0 - 1 Goal! Amine Adli plays it to Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Kevin Muller. 0:1.
45+1' Kevin Muller leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).

45+1' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Bayer Leverkusen get a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and signals a foul after Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) brought his opponent down.
40' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes. 40:60 – the ratio of ball possession.
37' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
36' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
35' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
35' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

34' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Kevin Muller. This effort really didn't trouble him.
34' The game is interrupted. Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
28' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) dribbles into the box, but Kevin Muller is quick enough to come off his line and stop him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
26' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
23' The Bayer Leverkusen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
22' A player from Heidenheim commits a rough challenge. Harm Osmers blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Bayer Leverkusen.
21' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

20' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
18' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
17' The ball is cleared after Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Corner kick. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity.
15' The free kick from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
15' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Heidenheim is cautioned for aggressive play.
13' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
12' Looks like Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
11' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find Jeremie Frimpong, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
10' Harm Osmers blows for a foul after Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
9' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen).
7' The linesman signals that Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
6' A corner kick by Heidenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Lukas Hradecky (Bayer Leverkusen).
3' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
2' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bayer Leverkusen will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Harm Osmers.
